title: Why Most Habits Fail in 2 Weeks: The Hidden Reason Goals Collapse
description: Why Most Habits Fail in 2 Weeks is rarely about discipline and more about how routines are designed. Learn the psychology of habit formation, behavior change, and self-improvement strategies that help new routines survive stressful days. This guide explains why motivation fades, how small actions build consistency, and includes a deeper five-question reflection check to adjust habits that keep breaking. Tap to read the full guide.
